title: Pentagon UFO files: what role Germany plays
description: For years, The New York Times has followed the release of US UFO files. The newly accessible documents go beyond sightings, tracing back to World War II and repeatedly mentioning Germany.

title: Pilot issues 'flying saucer' alert after spotting UFO while landing at Gatwick
description: The pilot of a commercial plane coming in to land at Gatwick Airport reported seeing a "flying saucer" which was terrifyingly just feet away from the aircraft

title: The man who phoned in Canada's most famous UFO sighting became the face of the mystery
description: The Oct. 4, 1967, Shag Harbour event is considered Canada's most famous UFO incident. Laurie Wickens became the public face of the mystery, a role he kept until his recent death at 76.

description: WE TAKE a look at the stories making the headlines in East Lothian 25, 50 and 100 years ago.
